notes.title: Version 3.7.0 (37001)
notes.notes:
[h2]🛠 Custom Models Supercharged[/h2]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/p1KLkdB/Frame-5.png[/img]

Enjoy up to [b]70% faster execution times[/b] when using custom ML models.

[b]Other Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Custom models are now automatically saved after import
[*] Output filenames now include the custom model name as a suffix (can be disabled in Settings)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 3.5.0 (35000)
notes.notes:
[h3]🚀Lightning fast upscaling and enhancements on Windows[/h3]
We've rewritten the image processing engine to take advantage of better hardware-accelerated machine learning APIs provided by DirectML. You can expect up to 70% faster executions times!

notes.title: 🚀Lightning fast upscaling and enhancements are now available in alpha!
notes.notes:
[b]🚀Lightning fast upscaling and enhancements are now available in alpha![/b]
If you experience issues or want to share your experience, please send a e-mail at beta@superimage.io

NOTE: custom models currently don't use the new high-performance backend

[b]How to join the alpha:[/b]
[list]
[*] Open your Steam library
[*] Right click on SuperImage Pro
[*] Click on Properties>Beta
[*] Select alpha under the Beta Participation option
[*] Enjoy !
[/list]
